findings.title: Valid named route parameters are rejected as non-UUID
findings.trigger: Seed a real route such as /[locale]/franchise/questionnaires/[questionnaireId]/[tool] with an owned questionnaire UUID and tool=apercu.
findings.actual: The collector applies uuid.test to every non-catch-all parameter, returns INVALID_ROUTE_PARAMETERS, and cannot plan the legitimate case.
findings.expected: UUID validation applies to resource identifier keys; safe non-identifier route parameters retain the type/value semantics of the corresponding page.
findings.recommendation: Differentiate resource IDs (id and *Id) from named segments; add coverage for a valid questionnaire tool/module path and retain traversal rejection. Domain allowlists can additionally prevent phantom modules.
findings.resolution: UUID validation is now restricted to id/*Id; safe named route segments are accepted, with a new enum/invalid-ID test.

findings.title: An arbitrary access failure can satisfy an expected fiscal FORBIDDEN gate
findings.actual: expectedGateCovered=true and hasIssue=false; MFA_REQUIRED and CONFIGURATION produce the same false-positive result.
findings.expected: Only the exact expected fiscal authorization refusal should satisfy that gate; expired login, MFA and infrastructure/configuration failures must fail.
findings.recommendation: Preserve the matched gate code in the scanner and require the exact expected code. Independently detect crash patterns even when another gate is present. Add negative cases for unrelated gate codes and gate+technical-failure combinations.
findings.resolution: Expected fiscal coverage now requires the exact FORBIDDEN token. The scanner retains the matched code and computes technical/crash failures independently. Redirect, origin, organization and franchise mismatches are separately rejected.
